ipv6DataPlane.note: TLS ok over IPv6, cert CN=cloudflare-dns.com

findings: This host has no direct IPv6 egress, but the tunnel carried an IPv6 TLS handshake to 2606:4700:4700::1111 (TLS ok over IPv6, cert CN=cloudflare-dns.com). IPv6 is covered *through* the tunnel — there is no v6 path outside it to leak onto, and no v6 coverage gap in the tunnel itself.
DNS was measured separately (DNS_TUNNEL_PROOF): resolution now happens through the tunnel on TCP/53, so names no longer go to the local resolver.
notCovered: IPv6 through the tunnel (no coverage to test until IPv6 targets are accepted).
UDP/QUIC leak behaviour — the SOCKS listener is TCP-only here.
Traffic from another interface or a second resolver configured by the OS.
